_comment: scripts/check-logs.py: these journal entries go through the real redaction steps into a throwaway VictoriaLogs, then vmalert runs deploy/logs/alerts/ on them. 'expect' lists, per alert, the values of its key label it must fire (or wait to fire) for, and no others: client_ip, hospital for PackApplyFailed, PackFacilityDeferred, HospitalNotServed, ReleaseWindowOverrun, AuditHospitalCheckFailed, AuditHospitalSealLate, DumpHospitalFailed, DumpHospitalHeld HospitalRestoreFailed and HospitalRootProblem, schema for ParkedSchemaOverdue, or reason for DatabaseRoleRefused (hospital for BatchRequestRefused, StaffResetRefused and the three MrdRecords alerts). P1-T27a: PrivilegedLoginUnrecorded is compared by its application name (app) and OperatorSessionRefused by its refusal code (why), one value per firing group (P1-T27 review O9; the redaction cases are stored too: their e-mail-named postgres login and their shared-operator refusal fire as well); KeycloakAdminCredentialChange the admin's client_ip.
